claim: KATNP Gorkha spectra peaked at ~0.4 s and ~5 s, far above code; 475-yr UHS misestimates demand by period.
stance_target: Basin effects/long-period pulses matter for Kathmandu scenarios
quoted_support: Elastic response spectra of the mainshock near the centre of the Valley (KATNP station operated by USGS) contained two very distinct peaks: a narrower and larger peak at ~0.4 s and a smaller, but very wide, peak at ~5 s.
